item.tib: dbal gsas sku rdzogs rtsa rgyud gsang ba don 'grel gyi bstod 'grel
item.coloph: e ma ho/ rgyud gsang ba don 'grel yi dam rtsa ba'i rgyud 'di/ bla chen dngos su byon pa'i rma ston shes rab seng ge yis/ sham po dpal nas bdan (gdan) drangs/ rgya rigs bru la gnang / shog ser bu la dper 'drar zhal bshus so/ 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ las ldan shes rgyud khrol nas kyang / 'gro ba'i don du nyi zer bzhin du rgyas par shog/
